description: Refusal fixture (data-model.md §9, PRD FR-20): questions the simulated NX-320 corpus cannot ground. Includes other fictional aircraft types (never real ones, per data-ethics.md), nonexistent procedures, and fleet-current-status questions. In the ask flow (F3) each must end refused (100% gate); in the F2 retrieval mode they are informational. expected_reason uses the machine-readable refusal taxonomy.
